# heki

> Experimental Effect & Alias semantic checker for Python: shared-state, async-blocking, N+1 and quadratic-loop bugs that Ruff and type checkers do not see.


## Docs

- [Overview](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/): heki (Japanese for "wall") checks **what Python code does** across functions and modules: which
- [Scope and Limitations](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/scope/): heki checks what Python code does across functions and modules: which objects it mutates,
- [Installation](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/installation/): heki is a single executable
- [Getting Started](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/getting-started/): From the root of a project (the directory with pyproject.toml):

## Usage

- [Configuration](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/configuration/): heki reads [tool.heki] from pyproject.toml, or a heki.toml / .heki.toml file (same keys
- [Fixes and Safety](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/fixes/): Every OPT rule detects a quadratic or linear-per-iteration pattern and knows a faster
- [Adopting heki in a Code Base](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/adoption/): An existing code base usually has findings you cannot fix at once
- [CLI Reference](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/cli-reference/): Exit codes: 0 no diagnostics, 1 diagnostics (or Ratchet regressions, or pending --diff changes), 2 configuration / I/O / syntax errors

## Docs

- [Rules](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/): heki has 30 rules in four families

## Integrations

- [Editors (LSP)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/lsp/): heki server (alias heki lsp) is a Language Server Protocol server on stdin / stdout
- [Coding Agents](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/coding-agents/): heki's output is designed to be acted on by people and by coding agents (Claude Code, Codex,

## Docs

- [Development](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/development/): $ cargo build

## Rules

- [async-blocking-call (EFF101)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/async-blocking-call/): Family: Execution Effects (EFF) · Enabled by default · No automatic fix
- [async-blocking-fs (EFF105)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/async-blocking-fs/): Family: Execution Effects (EFF) · Opt-in · No automatic fix
- [cached-property-stale-mutation (MUT101)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/cached-property-stale-mutation/): Family: Mutation & State (MUT) · Enabled by default · No automatic fix
- [call-owner-violation (MUT204)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/call-owner-violation/): Family: Mutation & State (MUT) · Enabled by default · No automatic fix
- [effect-boundary-violation (EFF201)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/effect-boundary-violation/): Family: Execution Effects (EFF) · Enabled by default · No automatic fix
- [hash-attr-mutation (MUT107)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/hash-attr-mutation/): Family: Mutation & State (MUT) · Enabled by default · No automatic fix
- [immutable-quadratic-concat (OPT103)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/immutable-quadratic-concat/): Family: Complexity Rewrites (OPT) · Enabled by default · No automatic fix
- [iterator-double-consumption (MUT106)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/iterator-double-consumption/): Family: Mutation & State (MUT) · Opt-in · No automatic fix
- [list-front-insert (OPT121)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/list-front-insert/): Family: Complexity Rewrites (OPT) · Enabled by default · Proven-safe suggestion (--fix --include-size-dependent)
- [list-front-pop (OPT120)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/list-front-pop/): Family: Complexity Rewrites (OPT) · Enabled by default · Proven-safe suggestion (--fix --include-size-dependent)
